fioraRHealingEvidence.englishDescription: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on an enemy champion and gains Move Speed while near them. If Fiora hits all four Vitals or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds.
fioraRHealingEvidence.englishTooltip:
Passive: Duelist's Dance Move Speed bonus is increased to {{ percentms*100 }}%.

Active: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on a champion for a max of {{ spell.fiorapassive:rdamagetotal }} max Health true damage and gains Duelist's Dance's Move Speed bonus while near the target.

If Fiora strikes all four Vitals within {{ markduration }} seconds or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora restores {{ healpersecondcalc }} Health per second to surrounding allied champions for {{ healduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

被动：{{Spell_FioraPassive_Name}}移动速度加成提升至@PercentMS*100@%。

如果菲奥娜在@MarkDuration@秒内命中了全部四处破绽，或者在目标死前至少命中一处，那么菲奥娜就会为周围的友方英雄每秒回复@HealPerSecondCalc@生命值，持续@HealDuration@秒。

source.englishDescription: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on an enemy champion and gains Move Speed while near them. If Fiora hits all four Vitals or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds.
source.englishTooltip:
Passive: Duelist's Dance Move Speed bonus is increased to {{ percentms*100 }}%.

Active: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on a champion for a max of {{ spell.fiorapassive:rdamagetotal }} max Health true damage and gains Duelist's Dance's Move Speed bonus while near the target.

If Fiora strikes all four Vitals within {{ markduration }} seconds or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora restores {{ healpersecondcalc }} Health per second to surrounding allied champions for {{ healduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
source.chineseTooltip:
被动：{{Spell_FioraPassive_Name}}移动速度加成提升至@PercentMS*100@%。

主动：菲奥娜标出一名英雄身上的全部四处破绽，最多可造成@spell.FioraPassive:RDamageTotal@最大生命值的真实伤害并在目标附近时获得{{Spell_FioraPassive_Name}}的移动速度加成。

如果菲奥娜在@MarkDuration@秒内命中了全部四处破绽，或者在目标死前至少命中一处，那么菲奥娜就会为周围的友方英雄每秒回复@HealPerSecondCalc@生命值，持续@HealDuration@秒。
